builds.name: Reference: AP sustained duel
builds.goal: Reference for Mordekaiser: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A sustained melee magic fighter who activates an aura through contact and isolates a target for an extended duel. Keep passive activation, isolated Q and R duel state explicit. Shield-to-heal choices use the same stored resource; Dusk/on-hit value needs real attacks. AP plus real attack cadence tests sustained contact and later penetration.
builds.summary: AP plus real attack cadence tests sustained contact and later penetration.
testPlan: Kit question for Mordekaiser: Keep passive activation, isolated Q and R duel state explicit. Shield-to-heal choices use the same stored resource; Dusk/on-hit value needs real attacks.

Start with the early core (Riftmaker, then Nashor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Shield. Do not treat mana regeneration as Shield recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP plus real attack cadence tests sustained contact and later penetration. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Nashor needs actual attacks; little health/resistance makes CC and burst dangerous.

The route fails Mordekaiser's stated kit question: Keep passive activation, isolated Q and R duel state explicit. Shield-to-heal choices use the same stored resource; Dusk/on-hit value needs real attacks.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Nashor needs actual attacks; little health/resistance makes CC and burst dangerous.
Full cost 17,000 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Riftmaker, then Nashor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: Shield. Do not treat mana regeneration as Shield recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with Nightfall dealing [80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 7.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.7) × AP] magic damage, increased to [(80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 7.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.7) × AP) × (1.3 / 1.35 / 1.4 / 1.45 / 1.5)] if it hits only a single enemy.

Passive: Mordekaiser stores [45]% of the damage he deals and [7.5]% of the damage he takes.

Active: Mordekaiser gains the stored damage as Shield. He may Recast this Ability to restore [(0.35 / 0.375 / 0.4 / 0.425 / 0.45) × 100]% of the remaining Shield as Health.

Minimum Shield: [(0.05) × Stat(12)]
Maximum Shield: [(0.3) × Stat(12)]

Passive: Mordekaiser gains [(0.05 / 0.075 / 0.1 / 0.125 / 0.15) × 100]% Magic Penetration.

Active: Pulls enemies in his direction, dealing [60 / 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage.

Mordekaiser banishes a champion to the Death Realm with him for [7]s, stealing [10]% of their core stats for the duration.

If Mordekaiser kills that enemy in the Death Realm he consumes their soul, keeping the stats he stole until the target respawns.

Mordekaiser's Attacks deal an additional [(0.4) × AP] magic damage.

Mordekaiser cloaks himself in negative energy after hitting 3 basic Abilities or Attacks against champions or jungle monsters.
